notes: BOF slag as additive in KOH geopolymer of gold mine tailings; UCS and leaching. UCS ages from 3 d to 90 d; values in notes.

1 Scientific Literature.Title: A comparison between fly ash- and basic oxygen furnace slag-modified gold mine tailings geopolymers
1 Scientific Literature.Journal_or_Source: International Journal of Energy and Environmental Engineering 11:207-217
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Compare fly ash and BOF slag as additives to gold mine tailings geopolymers for strength and heavy metal immobilisation.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: 50% replacement of tailings gave highest UCS: 21.44 MPa for BOF-based (cured 70 °C, 10 M KOH) vs 12.98 MPa for FA-based (90 °C, 15 M KOH). BOF geopolymers formed C-S-H/C-A-S-H and immobilised >94% Fe vs 76% for FA. 12-month leaching showed insignificant pollution threat.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Alkali-activated binder; slag replaces mine tailings, not Portland cement.
